query:
insert into TestCaseLineCoverageOverrides (
                                    collect_nr,
                                    product_id,
                                    test_collect_nr,
                                    test_run_name,
                                    test_run_date,
                                    test_case_name,
                                    review_name,
                                    review_date,
                                    cov_filepath,
                                    cov_line,
                                    hits,
                                    comment_hash
                                )
                                select
                                    $1,
                                    $2,
                                    tc.collect_nr,
                                    $3,
                                    $4,
                                    $5,
                                    $6,
                                    $7,
                                    $8,
                                    $9,
                                    $10,
                                    $11
                                from TestCases tc
                                where tc.collect_nr = (
                                    select max(ctc.collect_nr)
                                    from TestCases ctc
                                    where ctc.product_id = tc.product_id
                                )
                                and tc.product_id = $2
                                and tc.test_run_name = $3
                                and tc.test_run_date = $4
                                and tc.name = $5
